overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Council and Committee minutes were sufficiently detailed, with "Agenda packet (attached)" adequately identifying the documents used, and the January 3 minutes needed no document list.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged Council and Committee minutes for Dec 28 2021, Jan 3 and Jan 18 2022 were insufficiently detailed because they did not list the documents used at the meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Even though the Council and Committee did not separately list in the minutes each document used during the meetings, the documents here are kept and labeled in such a way as to make them transparent and easily accessible.
